text:
rachel: Quick heads-up — I'm taking the morning off next Wed. Can someone chair the ARB compact block at 11:00? Also want to trial a 30m "one-pager" cadence: each presenter drops a one-pager + 2 clarifying Qs, then decision vote. Thoughts?

alex: I can take the chair for that slot, no problem. Will keep strict timers. :thumbsup:

maria: thumbs — do you want the sharding RFC as a blunt summary + decision or a 10m walkthrough? I can prepare a 1-pager that ends with a clear roll/no-roll recommendation.

rachel: summary + decision only please. If folks want deeper dives we do a follow-up async thread or extra meeting. Goal: leave with a binary outcome.

kevin: we need 7-8 mins to surface the KV-cache deprecation migration checklist. Not an RFC but customers will need a clear plan and dates.

jess: suggested order: 1) sharding 1-pager (5m), 2) smart-routing quick callouts (8m), 3) KV deprecation plan (8m), 4) leftover triage + immediate action assignment (rest). Keeps it decision-focused.

alex: ordering sounds good. I'll add a 1-line "decision" at the end of each item and call for a quick thumbs-based vote. Can presenters drop their slides/one-pagers in the agenda doc by EOD Monday?

maria: yes — uploading sharding 1-pager now: https://docs.internal/redwood/arb/sharding-onepager

kevin: paste in the migration checklist and tentative timeline into the doc in a bit.

infra-bot: Calendar event created: "ARB — compact review (one-pager)" Wed 11:0011:30, guests: eng-platform, eng-runtime, archs. Event link: https://calendar.internal/event/ARB-COMPACT-4321

rachel: Alex — can you add the meeting note template (decision + owner + follow-up ETA) at the top of the doc? That will make action handoffs explicit.

alex: done — added a tiny template and an owners table. Also added a "handoff if code review needed" block so eng-oncall doesn't get noisy pings.

jess: tiny ask: if any item spills into code-review work, can we mark the action with a follow-up owners list and optional reviewers? That should reduce context-switching.

alex: yep — owners + optional reviewers section added. I'll enforce the 2-min decision window per item during the meeting.

maria: can we tack on a 1-slide perf snapshot for sharding? Two charts: token p95 and throughput by batch size. I'll drop images in doc before EOD.

kevin: grabbing p95 and median latency from console now, will paste values plus the coarse migration ETA.

rachel: perfect. I'll do a final doc pass Tue morning and mark the calendar event as "compact". Thanks everyone :pray:

alex: :rocket:

jess: :white_check_mark:
